The Dimension-Tearing Disk is a post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. When used, it throws a disk that passes through tiles and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance. When thrown at nearby enemies, it will fire a nebula laser beam that deal 70% of the weapon's damage.

Performing a stealth strike with the Dimension-Tearing Disk causes the next boomerang thrown to deal 130% damage and not return to the player, but slightly stick to enemies and fire nebula laser beams that deal 20% base damage in random directions before dissipating.

Its best modifier is Flawless.

History

edit
These history sections are still a work-in-progress, and may not yet contain changes relevant to the current version of the Calamity Mod.
  • 2.2.0:
    • Nerfed damage from 980 to 725, and use time from 24 to 27. Stealth strikes now have a 130% damage modifier.
    • Changed the text effect used for Devourer of Gods-themed attack names in its tooltip.
  • 2.1.0:
    • Renamed from "Eradicator" to "Dimension-Tearing Disk".
    • Buffed damage from 620 to 980, and use time from 33 to 24. Stealth strikes no longer have a 60% damage modifier.
    • Disks now grant -1 local immunity frames instead of 9, which resets when they start returning.
    • Disks now fire a single magenta laser beam when they start returning instead of firing nebula shots every 8 frames, but laser beams deal 70% base damage instead of 40%.
    • Stealth strike disks now fire magenta laser beams while grinding instead of nebula shots, and laser beams deal 20% base damage instead of 12%.
  • 2.0.4.001: Increased sell price from 28 to 40 .
  • 2.0.3.006: Nerfed stealth strike damage modifier from 75% to 60%.
  • 2.0.3.003:
    • Buffed damage from 563 to 620, stealth strike damage modifier from 50% to 75%, and stealth strike laser damage from 12% base damage to 15%. Disks now start returning after 1 second instead of 0.67.
    • Disk now spins faster, and added visual sparks when it hits enemies.
  • 2.0.2.001: Now inflicts God Slayer Inferno for 3 seconds instead of On Fire! and Frostburn.
  • 1.5.1.001: Now inflicts On Fire! for 3 seconds instead of 10, and Frostburn for 1.5 seconds instead of 10.
  • 1.5.0.001:
    • Now exclusively deals rogue damage and has a stealth strike effect.
    • Buffed damage from 300 to 563, but it now grants enemies 18 local immunity frames instead of 3. Stealth strike projectiles now last for 2 seconds.
  • 1.4.5.001: Rogue variant can now trigger universal stealth strike effects.
  • 1.4.3.002: Variants now share their drop chance.
  • 1.4.3.001: Disk now functions in PvP.
  • 1.4.2.103: Now has afterimages.
  • 1.4.2.102:
    • Now inflicts On Fire! and Frostburn.
    • Lasers now inflict On Fire! for 10 seconds.
    • Added a tooltip.
  • 1.4.2.001:
    • Lasers now pierce infinitely instead of once and grant 2 local immunity frames.
    • Now has glowmasks.
    • Resprited. Previous sprite was
  • 1.4.1.001:
    • Buffed melee variant's damage from 225 to 300.
    • Nerfed rogue variant's damage from 450 to 300.
  • 1.3.4.101: Both variants' lasers now deal their respective damage instead of ranged damage.
  • 1.3.2.001: Buffed damage from 195 to 450.
  • 1.2.2.001: Buffed damage from 190 to 195.
  • 1.2.1.005: Nerfed damage from 200 to 190.
  • 1.2.1.004: Nerfed damage from 230 to 200.
  • 1.2.1.001: Nerfed damage from 250 to 230.
  • 1.2.0.001: Resprited. Previous sprite was
  • 1.1.7.971: Now lasts 3 seconds instead of 4, and ignores 3 immunity frames instead of setting them to 2.
  • 1.1.7.901: Removed tooltip "Annihilate!".
  • 1.1.7.851: Thrown projectiles now set NPC immunity frames to 2.
  • 1.1.7.806: Now passes through blocks instead of bouncing off them.
  • 1.1.7.801: Resprited. Previous sprite was
  • 1.1.7.701: Now uses the rarity instead of .
  • 1.1.7:
    • Buffed damage from 170 to 250.
    • Can no longer be crafted.
  • 1.1.6.1:
    • Buffed damage from 65 to 170, but nerfed use time from 14 to 18 and shot speed from 20 to 12.
    • Now uses the rarity instead of .
  • 1.1.5.08: Projectile now lasts 4 seconds instead of 10.
  • 1.1.5.02: Resprited. Previous sprite was
  • 1.1.4.44: Introduced a melee variant.
  • 1.1.4.43: Introduced.
